component.name: Iqbal Terminal
component.summary: SSH terminal with SFTP file manager, floating windows and a text editor

description.p: Iqbal Terminal is a multi-session SSH client in the spirit of PuTTY and MobaXterm. It supports PEM, OpenSSH and PuTTY PPK keys, saved sessions, themes and a system tray icon.

ul.li: SFTP file manager: browse remote folders, upload and download files or whole folders
Picture-in-picture: float any session in its own always-on-top window
Built-in rich text editor with Markdown, plain text and HTML export
Dark, light and black-and-green themes with many terminal color schemes

description.p: SFTP file manager, black-and-green theme, PiP windows and rich text editor.
